OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise '+61' is assumed and a single leading
            '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must carry 8 to 15
            digits after the '+'. The normalized E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.

## Summary

I implemented the duplicate-household rejection for `POST /api/owners`, following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions (mirroring the existing `CheckOwnerTelephoneUnique` step).

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added a `sharesHousehold` boolean to the `OwnerFields` schema so the request DTO exposes the opt-in flag (documented as create-time-only, not persisted).

2. **`CheckOwnerHouseholdUnique.java`** (new) — Reads the published `OwnerFieldsDto`, and unless `sharesHousehold` is `true`, scans existing owners for one sharing both `lastName` and `address`, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace (`trim` + `\s+`→single space + `toLowerCase`). On a match it throws the checked `DuplicateHouseholdException`.

3. **`DuplicateHouseholdException.java`** + **`DuplicateHouseholdExceptionHandler.java`** (new) — Checked escalation and its handler responding **409 Conflict** with a `ProblemDetail`, consistent with `DuplicateTelephoneException`.

4. **Escalation YAML** — `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.escalation.DuplicateHouseholdException.yml` wires the exception to its handler.

5. **`owners.POST.yml`** — Inserted the `checkHouseholdUnique` step (under `govern: [ transaction ]`) between the telephone-uniqueness check and `build`.

Test results: `Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — covering rejection on same lastName+address, acceptance with a different address, and acceptance when `sharesHousehold` is true.
